name: Flowstep
description:
Flowstep is a design canvas that your agent can draw on.

Ask for a screen and you get one — real layout, real components, sitting on a canvas you can open and edit. Point at a .jsx or .tsx file and Flowstep reads the source, then designs the screen to match it. Ask for the empty state, the error state, the mobile version, and they appear alongside.

Nothing is a flat image. Nudge a screen with a follow-up instruction, redo it from scratch, or pull in a Figma frame as editable elements. Set your colours, type, and spacing once and every new screen follows them.

Useful when you're mid-build and need to see the thing before you commit to it — a checkout flow, a settings page, four takes on an onboarding screen. Works from Cursor, Claude Code, or any MCP client, so the design step happens where you're already working.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Flowstep to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Flowstep to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://api.flowstep.ai/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Flowstep MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Flowstep lists 20 MCP tools, including add-screen, create-file, create-new-design, delete-design-guidelines, delete-file, edit-design, expand-design, get-chat-history, get-design-guidelines, get-file, get-plan-details, and get-screen.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Flowstep?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Flowstep in design-creative on the Manufact MCP catalog include Motion, MotionVid, Sleek, Streamloop MCP, and Image Generation.
Flowstep requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Flowstep is developed by Flowstep. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
